items.text: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) now likely to miss Week 4 in London despite initial hope; late Q add. Thorman notes Diggs/Chig main beneficiaries, Williams/Treylon wildcards.
items.why: Hamstring popped Friday practice; beat sources confirm likely miss.
items.implication: WAS WR1 void; Diggs lead role.
items.opportunity: Diggs/others expanded targets/routes; Chig Okonkwo (IN) benefits.

items.text: ETR lists Puka Nacua as IN for Week 4 after missing time with hip/groin. Levitan notes great to have him back but some speculation on possible snap limits.
items.why: Cleared, full practice Friday per reports; McVay positive but snap count possible.
items.implication: WR1 upside returns vs PHI; monitor limits.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets volume rebound; Adams still viable if limited.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN. Levitan: excellent spot vs Cowboys (elite DvP inflating WR scoring 7.3%, Texans 7th-most implied points).
items.why: Hamstring cleared; Rapoport confirms good to go.
items.implication: Elite WR1 restart in smash spot.

items.text: Justin Jefferson OUT (ankle). Levitan: moment Jordan Addison truthers waiting for, home vs borderline secondary.
items.opportunity: Addison routes/targets spike; Jefferson short-term stash.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dallas Goedert OUT. Levitan: Eagles situation worse, without three key players (Smith/Goedert/Baun) vs Rams.
items.why: Smith hamstring, Goedert knee; Schefter confirms.
items.opportunity: Dontayvion Wicks and remaining pass-catchers see expanded routes/targets/RZ.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (foot) Q after LP-DNP-LP (also cracked rib earlier). Zay Flowers Q. Expecting some Qs like Sadiq to play.
items.why: Practice trends concerning for McConkey; Flowers hamstring history.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT. Beneficiaries implied in Jets backfield.
Mike Evans QUESTIONABLE (ribs). Rapoport: intends to play through painful injury with padding; Schefter GTD.
items.why: Ribs; plans to play but brutal.
items.implication: Monitor inactive; Kittle upside if limited/out.
items.opportunity: If out, TE/WR targets free up.

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest). Levitan: tough first month—lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, hurt, Charbonnet back at practice—but passes eye test, far from over long-term. Projections updated.
items.why: Chest injury + role erosion; Charbonnet practicing.
items.implication: SEA RB downgrade short-term; handcuffs up.

items.text: Lamar Jackson off injury report, good to go vs Titans. ETR had related INs like Pollard/Swift/Irving.
LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches, Dowdle out again; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. Top-10 play.
LOVE Jeremiyah Love: 26 touches last week (RB5 util), double-digit target share every game; NYG allows 5.1 YPC (3rd-most).
HATE Omarion Hampton: low util (RB27), 3.5% targets, 25% routes, 42% snaps Week 3, only 13% 3rd down; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
